title: 365. Ugly Number

examples.explanation: 6 factors as 2 * 3, using only allowed primes.
1 has no prime factors, so it is ugly by definition.
14 includes the prime factor 7, which is not allowed.

hints: Non-positive values can never be ugly.
Divide out factors 2, 3 and 5 completely; the value is ugly exactly when 1 remains.
